hook_text: 2 litres or 500 millilitres: which is more? The smaller number wins.
clip_script: Stellenbosch, making punch for the concert. Teaspoon: 5 ml. Cup: 250 ml. Can: 330 ml. Carton: 1 litre, that is 1 000 ml. Read the jug on a flat table, eyes level with the juice. Between 700 and 800: 750 ml. Look from above and it seems like 800. Now the bottles: 2 litres or 500 ml? 2 litres is 2 000 ml, so it wins easily. Line them up: 330, 500, 750, 1 000, 2 000 millilitres.
visual_style: Juice pouring into a jug with an eye-level line glowing, then bottles lining up by size.
mood: Fresh and festive, like getting ready for a party.
pacing: Benchmarks quickly, the eye-level trick, then the 2 litre twist.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and read the capacity on three containers at home.
